annotations.title: Find remote jobs from company career sites and remote-job feeds

description: Remote jobs straight from employers: hundreds of company job boards plus the Remote OK, Jobicy, Working Nomads and Himalayas feeds, keeping only roles the posting marks as remote. Normalized title, company, country, seniority, salary and skills; each job links to its source. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/remote-jobs-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.002 per job; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

countries.description: Keep jobs open to these countries: ISO codes ("US", "CA") or names.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 500). Cost scales with this.

min_annual_salary.description: Minimum yearly pay in the posting's currency (jobs without pay are kept).

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

title_includes.description: Keep jobs whose title contains any of these, e.g. ["engineer"].

name: find_remote_jobs

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Find remote jobs from company career sites and remote-job feeds
